description: Broad mite is a microscopic pest that attacks young plant tissues. It feeds on leaves, stems, and fruits by injecting toxic saliva that distorts plant growth. The damage causes severe deformation of leaves and fruits and can significantly reduce crop yield.
symptoms: Bronzing or darkening of leaf surface
Young tissues become hard and brittle
spread: Movement by insects such as whiteflies
management: Use resistant or tolerant varieties when available
biological_control: Predatory mites such as Neoseiulus californicus
Predatory mites such as Amblyseius swirskii
Predatory mites such as Phytoseiulus persimilis
Use of entomopathogenic fungi such as Beauveria bassiana
prevention: Control weeds that may host mites
Monitor regularly during warm humid periods
